clue.text: Married woman is 19

parts.note: Alice is a woman's first name

explanation.surface: Someone remarks that a wife is nineteen years old.
explanation.walkthrough: '19' looks like an age, but it points to the answer at 19-down, ILL WILL, which is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Spite and hostility are both malice, a desire to harm someone.

clue.text: 12's in charge, wearing decorations

definitions.note: plural of the answer at 12-across, physical examinations

indicators.note: wearing means the decorations go round the in-charge letters like clothing

parts.note: medals are military decorations

explanation.surface: Someone in command turns up in full regalia.
explanation.walkthrough: '12's' refers to 12-across, CHECK-UP, read as a plural.
explanation.definitionFit: Physical examinations by a doctor are routine health inspections.

clue.text: Helping you to forget three articles (not all in English)

parts.note: le is the French definite article, foreign as the bracket warns
the is the English definite article
an is the English indefinite article

explanation.surface: Grammar notes say three little words, some foreign, aid memory loss.
explanation.walkthrough: '(not all in English)' warns that one article, LE, is French. Lethe is the river of forgetfulness in Greek myth.
explanation.definitionFit: In myth, drinking from the river Lethe brought oblivion, so the adjective means causing forgetfulness.

clue.text: American titmouse, a little bird ending with a D

parts.note: a chick is a baby bird
dee is the spelt-out name of the letter D

explanation.surface: Describing a small North American songbird with a bit of fun about its tail.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ending with' is a link joining the pieces; the letter is written out as its name, as crosswords often do.
explanation.definitionFit: This small grey North American songbird belongs to the tit family, which Americans call titmice.

clue.text: Weaken when police come back in, and give up

indicators.note: in tells us the reversed police letters sit inside the word for weaken

parts.note: to abate is to lessen or weaken

indicators.note: come back means the police abbreviation is read backwards

parts.note: CID is the Criminal Investigation Department, British detectives

explanation.surface: A protester's resolve weakens when the police return, and they surrender.
explanation.walkthrough: 'come back' is the reversal signal and 'in' the container signal; CID is the British detective branch.
explanation.definitionFit: To renounce a throne or a duty is to relinquish it, as a monarch does on stepping down.

clue.text: Monkey that bees disturbed, similarly

indicators.note: disturbed means the letters of the three words are stirred up and rearranged

explanation.surface: A monkey upset by bees reacts the same way.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is used to introduce a parallel point, likewise in the same way.

clue.text: Run into fashionable cowardly fellow

parts.note: in means fashionable, in vogue
a cur is a contemptible, cowardly man

explanation.surface: Bumping into a trendy coward.
explanation.definitionFit: To run into debt or trouble is to bring it upon yourself.

clue.text: For instance, lower rent

parts.note: as, in the sense such as, means for instance
under means lower, beneath

explanation.surface: A landlord gives an example of a reduced tenancy charge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rent' looks like money paid to a landlord; it is the past participle of rend, torn.
explanation.definitionFit: Something torn apart is in pieces, split.

clue.text: Dane, perhaps, reads Kipling's book in English as well

indicators.note: in says Kipling's novel is placed inside the other letters

parts.note: so can mean also, as well
Kim is a novel by Rudyard Kipling

explanation.surface: A Scandinavian reader enjoys a Kipling novel in English too.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dane, perhaps': Greenland's Inuit are Danish citizens, so a Dane may be one.
explanation.definitionFit: Greenland is part of the Danish realm, so its Arctic native people hold Danish nationality.

clue.text: In holds I submit, to stay in practice

indicators.note: In placed before I says that piece sits inside the word for holds

parts.note: keeps means holds
I as a numeral is one
to hand in work is to submit it

explanation.surface: A wrestler caught in holds gives up, to keep fit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In holds' looks like wrestling grips, but 'In' is the container signal and 'holds' the outer word; 'I' is the Roman numeral one.
explanation.definitionFit: To retain a skill by doing it regularly is to keep it up so as not to get rusty.

clue.text: Terminated without a messy injury

indicators.note: messy says the letters of the first word are jumbled once the a is removed

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone sacked without warning suffers a nasty wound.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without a' removes the A from TERMINATED; 'messy' rearranges the remaining TERMINTED.
explanation.definitionFit: Detriment is harm or damage done to someone, so an injury in the broad sense.

clue.text: Bird call caught by chance

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught
luck is chance or fortune

explanation.surface: A birdwatcher happened to catch a bird's call by good fortune.
explanation.definitionFit: A hen's short throaty sound is the classic farmyard noise of a fowl.

clue.text: Foreigner said to come first 'at university examination

indicators.note: said means the foreigner's nationality is spoken, giving a word that sounds the same

parts.note: a Czech is a person from the Czech Republic, a foreigner to a Briton
up means in residence at university, as in up at Oxford

explanation.surface: A visitor from abroad is told to report first for a university exam.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to come first' just places the sound-alike before UP.
explanation.definitionFit: A medical once-over by a doctor is a routine inspection of health.

clue.text: It makes me a lord

indicators.note: makes signals that the letters of me a lord are formed into something new

explanation.surface: A newly ennobled man explains what his title does for him.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both definition and wordplay: 'makes' rearranges ME A LORD.
explanation.definitionFit: Being granted the rank of earl elevates a man to the peerage, making him a nobleman.

clue.text: Ruled and guided without having been elected

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the word for guided goes round the other piece

parts.note: led means guided
a party elected to power is in

explanation.surface: Someone governed and steered a country without ever winning a vote.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' looks like 'lacking', but here it carries its old meaning of outside, the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Paper ruled with parallel guide strokes for writing is the same as paper bearing rules.

clue.text: Gopher wood used for it — northern hardwood with spots about in it

indicators.note: in it says the reversed spots go inside the hardwood

parts.note: oak is a typical hardwood

indicators.note: about means the word for spots is turned around

parts.note: a rash is an outbreak of spots

explanation.surface: Biblical shipbuilding notes: the gopher wood was a spotted northern timber.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' is the reversal signal and 'in it' the container signal. Genesis says the vessel was built of gopher wood.
explanation.definitionFit: In Genesis God tells the patriarch to build the great vessel for the Flood out of gopher wood.

clue.text: It follows when crocuses are treated with sulphur

parts.note: S is the chemical symbol for sulphur

indicators.note: are treated means the flowers are worked over and rearranged

explanation.surface: Gardening advice: what comes after crocuses are dusted with sulphur.
explanation.walkthrough: 'are treated' rearranges CROCUSES together with S.
explanation.definitionFit: One who comes after another in a post or line takes over next.

clue.text: Tending to be incorporated with :14

parts.note: Inc is the abbreviation for incorporated, as in company names
the answer at 14-across, ruled

explanation.surface: Something likely to be merged with another numbered item.
explanation.walkthrough: '14' is the answer at 14-across, LINED. 'to be' and 'with' are link words.
explanation.definitionFit: Being disposed or prone towards something is leaning that way.

clue.text: Landlord breaks silence before the last of the ale

indicators.note: breaks signals that the word silence is broken up and reassembled
the last of points to the final letter of ale

explanation.surface: A pub landlord interrupts the quiet before serving the final drop of beer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'breaks' rearranges SILENCE to LICENSE, then 'the last of' adds the E from 'ale'.
explanation.definitionFit: A British pub landlord holds the licence to sell alcohol, so is the licence holder.

clue.text: I shall leave behind hard feelings

parts.note: I'll is the contraction of I shall
to will property is to leave it behind when you die

explanation.surface: A dying person promises a bequest despite resentment.
explanation.definitionFit: Animosity and resentment are the bad feeling borne towards someone.

clue.text: A lot of shops can have almost incredible novelties when they first open

indicators.note: the words open with their first letters, so only those initial letters are taken

explanation.surface: Big retail groups may offer amazing new products on opening day.
explanation.definitionFit: A group of stores under one owner trading under one name is a retail network.

clue.text: True-blue's claim about love

parts.note: a true-blue, a staunch Conservative, claims I am a ...
Tory, a member of the British Conservative Party, ends the claim

explanation.surface: A loyal Conservative declares a romantic attachment.
explanation.walkthrough: True-blue means a staunch British Conservative, whose claim is 'I am a Tory'.
explanation.definitionFit: Relating to romantic passion or sexual desire, as in amorous verse.

clue.text: One's left with a key

parts.note: one's is I's, using I as a numeral one
and means with, together

explanation.surface: Someone is left holding a key.
explanation.walkthrough: 'key' looks like a door key, but it is a cay, a low island.
explanation.definitionFit: A key, or cay, is a small low islet, as in the Florida Keys.

clue.text: Ruler taking a bit of fruit

explanation.surface: A monarch helps themself to a piece of fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: A female monarch in a Muslim state, or a sultan's wife; and a seedless dried grape, a small piece of dried fruit.

clue.text: Get some round number

indicators.note: round means the word for some goes around the other piece

parts.note: any means some, as in have you any

explanation.surface: Fetch a few approximate figures.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Get' in the sense that really gets me, irritates.
explanation.definitionFit: To get to someone is to irritate or bother them.

clue.text: On the whole, it provides protection

explanation.surface: Generally speaking, the thing offers cover.
explanation.definitionFit: An adverb meaning all things considered, and a loose protective garment worn over clothes for work.

clue.text: Foreign national I encountered therein

indicators.note: therein says the letters lie inside the words just before it

explanation.surface: A citizen of another country tells of someone they met inside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Foreign national' reads as one phrase, but only 'Foreign' defines; 'national' starts the run of letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Something strange or from another land is outlandish, belonging elsewhere.

clue.text: Brush blue carpet

parts.note: to dress hair is to brush and arrange it
down means sad or low, like feeling blue

explanation.surface: Cleaning instructions for a blue rug.
explanation.walkthrough: 'carpet' looks like a noun, but it is the verb meaning to reprimand.
explanation.definitionFit: To carpet someone is to haul them up for a telling-off, a severe scolding.

clue.text: Longing to swallow the drink lying around, but procrastinating

indicators.note: to swallow means the longing word takes the other piece inside it

parts.note: dying, as in dying for a drink, means longing

indicators.note: lying around means the drink word is turned the other way

parts.note: ale is a drink, beer

explanation.surface: Someone craving a drink that is left about still keeps putting things off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lying around' is the reversal signal and 'to swallow' the container signal; 'the' before 'drink' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Putting off a task again and again is postponing it.

clue.text: Produced a harsh sound, the band, for an audience

indicators.note: for an audience says the word is heard rather than read, so a sound-alike is meant

parts.note: braid is a band of woven trim

explanation.surface: A group of musicians make a grating noise in front of listeners.
explanation.walkthrough: 'band' looks like a group of musicians, but it is a strip of braid.
explanation.definitionFit: A donkey's loud harsh call is a bray, so making that noise.
